# Cumulative Web Inc — cumulativeweb.com (full briefing)

> Independent label platform: Music & Film · Clothing · Software & AI Agents.
> This is the long form of https://cumulativeweb.com/llms.txt — every machine surface, endpoint schema, and usage example.
> Contact for business & sync: hp@cumulativeweb.com
> Last verified: 2026-10-05

---

## 1. What Cumulative Web Inc is

Cumulative Web Inc (CWI) is an independent label platform run by Black Lansky. It covers: a 53-track music catalog across 7 artists (verified 2026-10-05 against the encrypted catalog.json source of truth), film and music-video production, apparel (cover-art tees, artist-designed skateboards), and software built for AI agents (the SANQA suite, Meta Muse connector packages, the Agent Deck gear line).

Public identity: Cumulative Web Inc / @cumulativeweb. Business & sync contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com.

---

## 2. Machine front door

### 2.1 AI-queryable API (Cloudflare edge, logged, licensed)

Base URL: https://cwi-machine-data.hp-ace.workers.dev (alias: https://data.cumulativeweb.com)

**Track search — GET /query?q=<keywords>**

Scored catalog search returning tracks with canonical Spotify IDs and match rationale.

- Request: `GET https://cwi-machine-data.hp-ace.workers.dev/query?q=post-trap+cyberpunk`
- Response (JSON, 200): `{ "query": "post-trap cyberpunk", "results": [ { "title": "...", "artist": "...", "score": 0.97, "spotify_url": "https://open.spotify.com/track/<id>", "match": "genre/mood rationale" } ] }`
- Same schema client-side: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/placement/query.js
- The placement layer underneath is a 31-track catalog graph (tracks.json 31 nodes, curators.json 20 nodes, edges.json 21 edges, schema-valid 2026-10-03)

**Crawl deltas — GET /changes?since=<ISO-8601>**

What changed since your last crawl. Poll this instead of re-fetching everything.

- Request: `GET https://cwi-machine-data.hp-ace.workers.dev/changes?since=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`

**Licensing — GET /license**

Machine-readable licensing terms. Summary: research crawling and citation with attribution are welcome; commercial AI training requires a license — contact hp@cumulativeweb.com. All data responses carry licensing headers.

**MCP — POST /mcp (JSON-RPC 2.0)**

Tool surface over the catalog, sync search, and knowledge graph.

- Endpoint: `POST https://cwi-machine-data.hp-ace.workers.dev/mcp`
- Tools: `search_catalog` (search tracks), `get_track` (one track's full record), `get_artist` (artist record), `sync_search` (placement-licensing search), `get_graph` (catalog knowledge-graph slice)
- Status 2026-10-05: staged, rolling out — not yet accepting JSON-RPC calls (verified via live probe 2026-10-05 13:20 EDT)
- Related live surfaces: the Agent Deck MCP server product card (https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-mcp-server, 28/28 tests green 2026-10-01) and the CWI MCP Server registry card: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/registry/cwi-mcp-server/

### 2.2 Catalog learning surface (GitHub Pages)

Base: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/

- llms.txt — catalog-graph briefing: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/llms.txt
- Machine front door: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/ai/ai-index.json (DataCatalog listing every dataset, entity, schema, document)
- Permanent entity IDs: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/id/<type>/<slug> (fetch the @id URL directly; body is JSON-LD)
- Relationship vocabulary: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/graph/ontology.jsonld (16 controlled terms)
- catalog.json — 53-track catalog, served live at https://cwi-machine-data.hp-ace.workers.dev/catalog.json
- graph.json — catalog knowledge graph: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/graph.json
- kit.json — AI learning kit; proxied with 1h edge cache at the worker
- Equip guide (10 steps, every step tested): https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/EQUIP-GUIDE.md
- Registry of equip-able gear and tools: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/registry/
- Cue sheets (per-track sync metadata): https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/cue-sheets/ (e.g. cue-sheets/zooted-zone.json)

## 3. The catalog

Verified 2026-10-05 against the catalog.json source of truth (decrypted internal copy): 53 tracks, 7 artists.

Artists and genre lanes:

- That Boy Hi Hat — alternative rap (flagship). Spotify artist ID `2f9j460EwjfvjYp3trBcb7`. Tracks: "Zooted Zone" (`0emH8ktA8x4DkOFLsG5xkW`, ~307,000 lifetime Spotify plays verified 2026-09-14), "Diabolique" (`2eSyWmIdPzEMyWejLb2LBj`), and the NO SKIPS EP. Genre flag: Post-Trap Futurism.
- Black Lansky — beats/instrumentals
- King Akeem — trap ("Star" 112,510 plays)
- Greg Porn — cyberpunk/new wave/next gen ("Pay Yourself", "On Edge")
- Dre50 — afrobeats/caribbean/R&B ("Pix", "vai vem vem")
- 183 Wildboi — rap rock/trap ("Stunt", "Full Moon")
- Fleekz — trap/R&B ("2K23 Corners")

Producers in orbit: Jeck Da General (co-produced Idol or Icon with Black Lansky), Hybrid (producer of "Diabolique").

Rights posture (owner-confirmed): 50/50 with every artist; Black Lansky clears master + publishing directly per song — one signature clears the whole song (direct clearance, no warranty language before interest exists).

## Embedding matrix for AI retrieval (workstream H, 2026-10-05)

Pre-computed 384-dim bge-small-en-v1.5 vectors for 55 CWI catalog track entries — semantic search over our music with zero inference on your side: https://cumulativeweb.com/data/catalog-embeddings.json (mirrors: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/embeddings/catalog-embeddings.json and, once deployed, https://cwi-machine-data.hp-ace.workers.dev/embeddings/catalog-embeddings.json). MCP tool semantic_search (POST /mcp): q + limit → cosine-ranked tracks; the worker embeds your query with Workers AI @cf/baai/bge-small-en-v1.5, the same model as the matrix. How an agent uses this: fetch the matrix once, embed your queries locally with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, cosine-rank against the 55 vectors — zero API calls per search. Build provenance and the exact source-text template: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/embeddings/EMBEDDINGS.md.
